subject: TideWave production: sudden throughput collapse and 5xx surge
messages:
From: Hemant Rao <hemant@tidewave.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@tidewave.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Checkout throughput collapsed — 5xx spike

Vivek,

We started seeing a sharp drop in checkout throughput at ~08:48 PDT and a correlated spike in 5xx responses and p95 latency. Our graphs show token-level throughput for the reserved pool falling to ~30% of our committed baseline; consumers are timing out and conversion is falling. This is hitting our customers now.

Contract: TW-ENT-2026-47 (reserved capacity). We have an enterprise SLA and this is jeopardizing it. I attached a short capture (capture_20270411.log) showing repeated 503s and backend slot exhaustion.

Please advise immediate mitigation steps. We need either a fallback to a warmed cluster or emergency capacity/bursting enabled. Also want an estimate for credit/comp if this isn't restored in the hour.

-Hemant
Head of Platform, TideWave Finance

Attachments: capture_20270411.log (log snippet, 120KB)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Hemant Rao <hemant@tidewave.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout throughput collapsed — 5xx spike

Hemant — thanks for the heads up and the logs. Im escalating to our engineering and ops leads now.

Immediate steps we are kicking off:
- Triage and root-cause: aditya is pulling pool-level metrics and kernel traces.
- Short-term mitigation: proposing to divert TideWave traffic to a warmed fallback cluster (will need authorization to consume reserved burst).
- Contingency: if fallback not possible within 20m, we will apply per-tenant throttles on background/low-priority jobs to free headroom.

Lauren (account), Aditya (eng): can you confirm ETA on the fallback and whether we can enable burst entitlement for TW-ENT-2026-47? I will set a 15:00 PDT exec sync if we need a manual approval.

Vivek
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout throughput collapsed — 5xx spike

Quick findings from the pool:
- Observed sustained GPU utilization >98% across the reserved pool nodes serving TW between 08:40-09:10.
- KV cache miss rate jumped ~4x after 08:37 which drove an intense token regen workload.
- Cross-tenant burst from a partner onboarding job correlated with the initial spike (trace id: trace-7b3c).

Immediate options (tradeoffs):
1) Route TW traffic to warmed fallback cluster (recommended): ~10-15m to route, requires temporary billing/ops flag to enable reserved burst capacity. Risk: additional cost, but minimal impact to latency.
2) Apply per-tenant emergency throttle on background jobs and reduce batch sizes for internal non-prod tenants: ~5-8m to enact; partial relief, may not fully recover p95.
3) Spin new instances and reprovision GPUs in same az: ~30-45m; higher risk (provision and initialization).

I attached raw pool-usage.csv and kernel-metrics.txt (short extracts). Im starting the fallback prep (warming container images and KV preload) while waiting the go-ahead. If we do fallback we should also snapshot the current KV cache to reduce cold-start penalty.

Aditya
Senior SWE, Runtime

Attachments: pool-usage.csv, kernel-metrics.txt
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Hemant Rao <hemant@tidewave.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout throughput collapsed — 5xx spike

Hemant — Im really sorry for the disruption, and thank you for the quick capture. We agree with Adityas assessment.

Proposal for immediate remediation (subject to your go/no-go):
- Enable reserved burst to route production traffic to our warmed fallback cluster (we will only consume what is required to restore baseline throughput).
- Apply emergency throttle on non-critical jobs for 30 minutes to stabilize KV cache and token pressure.
- Offer a one-time service credit of 30% for the impacted window while we investigate root cause and prevent recurrence.

If you approve, we will: (1) enable burst and start routing (10-15m), (2) apply throttles, and (3) run a post-mortem and share a timeline for durability fixes.

Can we hop on a quick call at 10:00 PDT to confirm? If you'd prefer a later time Ill escalate to execs for immediate sign-off.

—Lauren
Account Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Hemant Rao <hemant@tidewave.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, ops@tidewave.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout throughput collapsed — 5xx spike

Lauren — please proceed with the fallback and throttles. We authorize the temporary burst for recovery.

We appreciate a call at 10:00 PDT. Please share the dashboard link and an ETA for when baseline is restored. Also confirm how you will validate no data consistency issues from cache snapshots.

Thanks,
Hemant
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Hemant Rao <hemant@tidewave.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout throughput collapsed — 5xx spike

Post-action update (summary):
- At 10:07 PDT we enabled reserved burst and routed TideWave to the warmed fallback cluster.
- At 10:12 PDT we applied emergency throttles on low-priority tenant jobs.
- By 10:25 PDT baseline throughput recovered to ~92% of expected; p95 latency returned to acceptable bounds and 5xx rate dropped to background levels.

Next steps:
- Engineering will run a targeted post-mortem (owner: aditya_rao) with KV-cache cold-start mitigation and cross-tenant isolation improvements (ETA: 72 hours).
- CS will propose a formal credit calculation; Lauren will send a credit proposal and timeline by EOD.
- We will schedule a technical readout with your SRE team (link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/tidewave/throughput?range=1h)

Attachments: pool-usage.csv, kernel-metrics.txt (for your ops team).

Thanks for the fast coordination and patience; we will follow up with a formal RCA and remediation plan.

Vivek
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
